required_before_ingest: record exact dataset license and access terms
compute exact and perceptual cross-dataset overlap
assign the highest-risk source group before splitting
map labels through a dataset-specific adapter without changing biological meaning
policy.warning: An article's license does not automatically establish the license of a separately distributed dataset.

datasets.license: Upstream card says MIT and requires gated acceptance; preserve the accepted terms with the artifact.
datasets.domain: Ground-based rice canopy imagery from five countries and all growth stages.
datasets.size: 3,078 RGB/mask tiles, 512x512, six semantic classes, 773 inferred source-photo groups.
datasets.recommended_role: Primary rice-domain semantic encoder calibration and protected-rice/weed mask pretraining.
datasets.do_not: Do not split overlapping tiles or derivatives from one source photo across partitions.

datasets.size: 1,347 images, 39,556 boxes: 39,065 rice and 491 weed; no valid/test split in the received archive.
datasets.geometry: COCO boxes; segmentation fields are empty
datasets.group_key: original site/session/pass family; filename family is only a temporary proxy
datasets.recommended_role: Target-domain detector fine-tuning after provenance recovery, mask annotation, negative collection, and grouped split reconstruction.
datasets.do_not: Do not report generalization from an image-random split or infer sprayable area from the complement of rice boxes.

datasets.domain: Jiangmen, China paddy at about 20 days after transplanting; Canon camera 0.8-1.2 m above the field.
datasets.geometry: semantic masks: rice seedling, Sagittaria trifolia weed, background/water/reflection
datasets.recommended_role: Closest public segmentation bridge to early-stage local paddy imagery; auxiliary encoder/mask supervision.
datasets.do_not: Do not random-split 224 derivative tiles. Check hashes and perceptual overlap before merging because this source is widely reused.

datasets.license: Archive terms must be accepted and recorded; do not infer them from the CC BY paper.
datasets.domain: One Taiwanese rice field, nadir UAV at about 20-23 m, three early-growth missions.
datasets.size: 600 320x320 detector images with 22,438 VOC rice boxes; 54,628 separate classification patches.
datasets.geometry: rice bounding boxes and image-level classification patches
datasets.recommended_role: Rice-protect localization warm-up and density/size robustness study.
datasets.do_not: Do not treat neighboring crops or repeated dates as independent samples; it supplies no weed-target masks.

datasets.domain: Two Vietnam Mekong Delta rice fields, four dates across three seasons, UAV at 12/20 m.
datasets.size: 734 aligned RGB plus four-band multispectral samples and 734 expert-corrected binary masks, processed to 1280x960.
datasets.recommended_role: Hard phenotype-confusion challenge and optional domain-adaptation auxiliary data.
datasets.do_not: Do not map weedy rice automatically to ordinary weed_target; its similarity to protected rice is the point of the challenge.

datasets.domain: Soybean fields in Maharashtra, India; ground and UAV captures across July-November 2023.
datasets.size: 18,677 images over 16 weed species; 6,656 weed samples with boxes, 7,577 crop samples, and 282 UAV images.
datasets.geometry: weed bounding boxes plus image-level crop material
datasets.recommended_role: Broad boxed-weed visual vocabulary and detector-head auxiliary pretraining.
datasets.do_not: Never map soybean or other crops to rice_protect.

datasets.domain: Sorghum fields in Tamil Nadu, India under varied light, weather, and distance.
datasets.size: 252 6000x4000 parent images and 5,555 manually annotated segments.
datasets.geometry: sorghum, grass, and broadleaf weed segmentation in COCO/JSON/CSV forms
datasets.do_not: Do not mix its crop label into protected rice or trust an image-level split without parent/session audit.

datasets.domain: Smartphone images of rice-field weeds from Narsingdi and Munshiganj, Bangladesh.
datasets.size: 3,632 images across 11 weed species in the paper/Hugging Face mirror.
datasets.group_key: recover EXIF/session and cluster by perceptual similarity before splitting
datasets.recommended_role: Weed appearance/classification pretraining or source for a newly mask-annotated subset.
datasets.do_not: Do not use image-level classes as detector boxes or masks.

datasets.domain: Ground-robot RGB-D imagery under natural light in Austria; seven crops and ten weeds, no rice.
datasets.size: 2,568 dense RGB-D mask samples over 25 dates in 2020-2021.
datasets.recommended_role: Generic plant segmentation and optional RGB-D ablation only.
datasets.do_not: Do not map any non-rice crop to rice_protect. The Hugging Face Data Studio image table alone does not expose the label fields; use the original release or FiftyOne loader.

datasets.license: Custom non-commercial research license; redistribution prohibited.
datasets.domain: Top-down Austrian commercial fields and experimental plots over four years; no rice.
datasets.size: 8,034 annotated high-resolution images and about 112,000 plant instances over 74 species.
datasets.geometry: boxes, semantic masks, stem points, and capture-condition metadata
datasets.recommended_role: Large generic localization pretraining or a research-only transfer control if license isolation is acceptable.
datasets.do_not: Do not redistribute or silently contaminate a future commercial model lineage. The generic Hugging Face Parquet/Data Studio view shows media rows, not the full FiftyOne annotations.

datasets.domain: DJI Mavic Pro paddy imagery acquired in 2018.
datasets.size: 400 original 4096x2160 UAV images with panicle segmentation annotations; multi-resolution derivatives are distributed separately.
datasets.do_not: It has no weed labels and is far larger than needed for the first pilot.

datasets.license: No permission to share reported in the paper.
datasets.domain: Two Hunan paddy sites over three growth sessions.
datasets.size: 995 original images with three boxed rice-field weed classes.
datasets.do_not: Do not scrape figures, reconstruct the dataset, or claim it is publicly available.

datasets.license: No public data archive/license located; paper directs inquiries to authors.
datasets.domain: Handheld top/lateral views at roughly 30 cm in Yunnan upland rice.
datasets.size: 986 originals with five boxed weed classes.
datasets.recommended_role: Excellent geometry match if explicit access and rights are granted.
datasets.do_not: Do not treat paper availability as dataset permission.

datasets.license: Not stated in the article; data statement directs inquiries to the corresponding authors.
datasets.domain: Rice paddy weeds captured in paired laboratory and field subsets.
datasets.size: 3,800 images (1,800 laboratory, 1,800-2,000 field) with pixel-level instance masks over six paddy weed species.
datasets.species: barnyard grass (Echinochloa crus-galli), purple nutsedge (Cyperus rotundus), eclipta (Eclipta prostrata), Cardamine occulta, alligator weed (Alternanthera philoxeroides), water dropwort (Oenanthe javanica)
datasets.recommended_role: Highest-match paddy weed mask source located; ideal independent validation/test for unseen-site weed segmentation if authors grant access.
datasets.do_not: Do not treat paper availability as dataset permission; these six-species masks are request-only and their license is unrecorded.

datasets.license: Not stated; the data-availability statement declares no datasets generated or analysed, so access requires contacting the authors.
datasets.domain: UAV remote-sensing imagery of rice paddy (Shenyang Agricultural University).
datasets.size: 3,094 tiles segmented from 171 original UAV images; boxed barnyard grass (single plants and continuous patches), rice, and field ridges.
datasets.recommended_role: High-match barnyard-grass box source for the dominant rice weed; contact target only.
datasets.do_not: Do not split tiles from one UAV image across partitions, and do not treat paper availability as dataset permission.
